manualBody: Invoice {number} for {amount} cannot be paid by card. Contact the gym to arrange a manual payment.
receiptBody: Payment of {amount} received for invoice {number}. Thank you.
failedBody:
The payment for invoice {number} could not be collected. Pay this invoice: {payUrl}
Update your saved card: {updateUrl}
actionBody:
Your bank requires authentication for invoice {number}. Complete payment: {payUrl}
Update your saved card: {updateUrl}
duplicateBody: An additional card payment of {amount} arrived for invoice {number}, which was already paid. An automatic refund was queued. Check the refund status in billing.
duplicateReleasedSubject: Duplicate payment for invoice {number} wasn't refunded automatically
duplicateReleasedBody: The automatic refund of a duplicate payment for invoice {number} was stopped. {amount} of that payment isn't recorded as refunded yet, though a refund made in Stripe may still be pending. Check the payment in Stripe and in billing, and refund the payer only what they are still owed.
refundFailedBody: A refund of {amount} for invoice {number} failed, so the payer did not receive it. Check the payment and its refunds in billing, and refund the payer another way only if they are still owed.
creditsReversedNote: The refund also took back {credits} unused class credits from the member's pack. If the payer is still owed the pack, add those credits back on the member's Packs tab.
creditsNotGrantedSubject: Class pack credits not granted for invoice {number}
creditsNotGrantedBody: Invoice {number} for a class pack ({amount}) was paid after its member's personal data was erased, so its {credits} credits weren't granted. Refund the payer from the invoice if they are owed it.
refundReversedBody: A refund of {amount} for invoice {number} was reported as successful but then failed, so the payer did not receive it. Check the payment in billing and refund the payer another way.
